interviewcake_highest-product-of-3.code:
class Solution:
    def HighestProductOf3(self, values: list[int]) -> int:
        high = max(values[0], values[1])
        low = min(values[0], values[1])
        high_pair = low_pair = values[0] * values[1]
        best = high_pair * values[2]
        for index in range(2, len(values)):
            value = values[index]
            best = max(best, value * high_pair, value * low_pair)
            high_pair = max(high_pair, value * high, value * low)
            low_pair = min(low_pair, value * high, value * low)
            high = max(high, value)
            low = min(low, value)
        return best
